title: Committed host test for redundant_slot.c (two-slot primitive)
description: Follow-up from worker6-b7z9.11.1: the two-slot redundant-record primitive (lichen/subsys/lichen/hal/redundant_slot.c) is verified by a standalone gcc harness but has no committed host test. Add lichen/tests/redundant_slot/ (CMakeLists via ../cmake/test_common.cmake, prj.conf, testcase.yaml, src/main.c) covering: empty->Missing, provision (+Exists on re-provision), open newest/alternation, corrupt-current -> Stale, corrupt-both -> EIO, stale via slot drop, generation wrap (-EOVERFLOW), rollback on write failure, and the CRC32 cross-check vector (Rust crc32 '123456789' -> 0xCBF43926; provision a record and assert the trailer bytes). The standalone harness logic is in the worker6-b7z9.11.1 close reason thread.
